# Kinet Solutions

> Kinet (Kinet Solutions) designs and builds software products for driven founders.

Kinet does the product design and engineering: web applications, mobile products, backend systems, and AI.

Some founders are building a technology company around a problem they believe software can solve. Some already have a business and want that offering delivered through a product.
